patterns.note: The page uses a high-contrast dark mode with large, expressive typography dominating the hero section, followed by an asymmetrical, two-column grid for portfolio project showcases.

A distinct typographic hierarchy is established using three font styles: a bold, classic serif for main descriptive lines, a clean sans-serif for body text and navigation, and an elegant, stylized script for personal emphasis.
The primary color scheme is stark black and white, creating a high-contrast, minimal aesthetic, with color introduced only through project imagery.

The main hero text remains fixed or slowly parallaxes in the viewport for a significant scroll distance, creating a persistent brand statement, while the navigation bar at the top becomes sticky after initial scroll.
Portfolio sections are presented as distinct blocks, each featuring a large image on one side and a concise text description on the other, creating a visually balanced yet dynamic layout.

technique_notes: To achieve the hero text effect, the large typographic elements are positioned to remain fixed or have a very slow parallax scroll speed, making them persist in the viewport as other content scrolls underneath. The header elements (logo and menu) transition to a fixed position at the top of the viewport once the user scrolls past the initial hero section.
Content sections are designed with generous vertical spacing and a dark background, allowing project images and text to stand out with high contrast.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, multi-style hero text (~6-8x body) with a mix of classic serif, clean sans-serif, and elegant script, contrasted with smaller, legible sans-serif body and navigation text.
design_tokens.spacing: very airy, with significant vertical padding between major sections and a balanced, open feel within content blocks.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its dramatic, multi-font hero typography that uses a combination of classic serif, clean sans-serif, and an elegant script to create a powerful, personal statement that remains fixed on screen for an extended scroll. The high-contrast black and white aesthetic further amplifies this bold typographic expression.
